ideas.title: Ants on a honey road, in the game
ideas.goal: Jumped in, the player holds H and drags a honey stick through the south meadow; the ants leave their nest, follow the honey, cut the corners on their own, and when enough of them reach the biscuit it starts to slide home crumb-trail behind it. Fun because the player steers a crowd by drawing, and the crowd answers with its own idea.
ideas.idea: physics/ants.jl (scent field, antennae, pull against friction) moves from the film script into a plugin: scent and ants on the GPU (Mantle kernel, 2000 ants), the biscuit a PrintSim-style box sliding with Coulomb friction under the summed pulls, crumbs breaking off at its corners. Someone watching sees a dark living line bend toward where the honey was, then straighten, then a biscuit creep across the grass.
ideas.form: Project ant-road's next step: a plugin (key H in Jump in), then a path traced close short of the biscuit moving, from a played moment.

ideas.title: Knock on anything
ideas.goal: The player knocks (K) on whatever stands in front of them, a pumpkin, a trunk, the cottage door, a stone lantern, and hears the note that object really makes; carve a bit off, and the note changes. Fun because the whole island turns into an instrument to find tunes in, and nobody tells you which thing sounds how.
ideas.idea: Modal sound synthesis: the object's own mesh gets a coarse tetrahedral FEM (PrintSim's FEM), its lowest eigenmodes and frequencies come from a generalized eigensolve, cached per asset; a knock excites the modes at the hit point (mode shape amplitude there) with material damping (wood, stone, gourd). A ring of the hit object shimmers visibly in its first mode shape, exaggerated.
ideas.form: A new plugin with a sound engine piece; a short film with sound: Lumi knocking a four-note tune off the stone lantern, the pumpkin and the swing post.

ideas.title: Dig a river
ideas.goal: With the shovel the player cuts a trench from the spring on the hill; water runs down it, pools, overflows where they dug too shallow, and if they lead it to the garden the flowers drink and open. Fun because water finds its own way and the player has to read the land to win.
ideas.idea: Shallow water equations on the island heightfield (a Mantle kernel, 256x256 cells, the pipe model), the shovel lowers the height under the blade and throws the soil aside as a bank; wet ground darkens, the water surface traced with a water dielectric. Watching: a thin silver line finding its way between the trees.
ideas.form: A plugin (shovel in Jump in) plus an engine change so the terrain mesh updates where it was dug; a traced short of a trench filling.

ideas.title: Throw a pot
ideas.goal: At a potter's wheel by the workshop the player spins clay and shapes it with the mouse (press in, pull up, open the top); too thin and it collapses, too fast and it wobbles off centre; fired in the kiln it holds water and sits on the shelf. Fun because the hands learn it: the first pots slump, later ones stand.
ideas.idea: Clay as a viscoplastic axisymmetric shell: a radial profile of rings with volume conserved, yield stress against the pressing hand, wall thinness and speed deciding a buckling collapse; firing turns the material from wet clay to glazed ceramic (Hikari coated diffuse). Watching: the lump rising into a cylinder under Lumi's wingtips.
ideas.form: A mini game at a new generated wheel asset; a traced short of a pot rising and one slumping.

ideas.title: Tightrope over the lily pond
ideas.goal: A rope spans the lily pond; the player walks it with A/D to shift weight and the mouse to swing the wings as a balance pole; wind gusts and the rope sways under them, and a fall is a real splash. Fun because balance is a skill you feel improving, and every crossing is a little drama.
ideas.idea: Lumi as an inverted pendulum with arms (todo #623's balance controller turned around: the player is the controller), the rope a PrintSim rod chain that sags and swings with Lumi's weight, gusts from the wind field. Watching: a yellow bird wobbling, wings out, over the water.
ideas.form: A plugin on Lumi's body plus a rope asset; a short of a crossing that ends in the pond.

ideas.title: A hot air balloon that steers by height
ideas.goal: The player fires a burner (hold space) to rise and vents to sink; the wind blows a different way at every height, so the only way to reach the islet is to find the layer that goes there. Fun because it is navigation by reading the sky (smoke, clouds, drifting seeds show each layer).
ideas.idea: Buoyancy from the envelope's air temperature (heat in from the burner, out through the fabric), a wind field with three layers that turn with height, drag on the envelope; the envelope cloth glows orange when the burner fires (an emissive flame inside a translucent fabric, path traced). Watching: a glowing balloon over the sea at dusk.
ideas.form: A ride in Jump in with a generated balloon asset; a traced dusk short.

ideas.title: Sand castles against the tide
ideas.goal: On the beach the player packs wet sand with a bucket, stacks towers and walls, and the tide comes in: dry sand runs, wet sand holds until a wave undercuts it. Fun because it is a race you always lose in the end, and the walls you built hold the sea back for a while.
ideas.idea: Granular sand as MPM particles on the GPU with cohesion from moisture (wet holds a steep face, dry rests at 34 degrees), waves from the shallows plugin wetting and eroding. Watching: a tower slumping grain by grain as a wave licks its foot.
ideas.form: A beach plugin with a bucket; a traced short of the tide taking a castle.

ideas.title: A marble run down the hill
ideas.goal: The player places wooden track pieces (straights, curves, a jump, a funnel) down the slope and lets a glass marble go; it rolls, flies, misses or makes it to the cup at the bottom, and friends cheer. Fun because it is building a machine and watching it fail and then work.
ideas.idea: PrintSim rigid bodies: the marble a sphere with rolling contact on the track meshes (IPC contact), spin and friction real, a glass marble traced with refraction and a coloured swirl. Watching: a glass marble catching the sun as it jumps a gap.
ideas.form: A build mode on the hill with generated track pieces; a traced short of a run.

ideas.title: Lead the moths with a lantern
ideas.goal: At night the player carries a lantern and the moths come; they don't fly to it, they tilt their backs to it and circle and stall, so leading them is a skill: walk too fast and they lose you, stop and they spiral. Bring them to the moonflowers and the flowers open. Fun because herding a swarm that obeys a strange real rule is a puzzle you solve with your feet.
ideas.idea: The dorsal light response (moths keep their backs to the brightest light, which traps them in orbits and stalls near a lamp, Fabian et al. 2024) simulated per moth with wingbeat flight; the lantern a real light in the tracer, the moths' wings scattering it. Watching: a whirl of pale wings around Lumi's lantern in the dark.
ideas.form: A night interaction in Jump in (builds on the moth system), a traced night short.

ideas.title: Shrink to ant size
ideas.goal: The player eats a seed and becomes ant-sized: the meadow is a jungle of grass blades, a dewdrop is a lens they can look through and push, a ladybird is a car-sized beetle, and getting back to the cottage is an expedition. Fun because a place you know becomes new and huge.
ideas.idea: The camera, Lumi and the physics scale down 50x: at that size surface tension and air drag rule (a dew drop holds its shape and Lumi bounces off it, falls are slow), the grass blades bend under Lumi's weight (per-blade springs), dewdrops are traced water spheres that focus sunlight. Watching: a tiny Lumi under grass blades backlit like a cathedral.
ideas.form: A Jump in mode with new near-ground geometry and dew; a traced low short.
